newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields rise on Bulgaria 6-, 9-mth floater T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields rise on Bulgaria 6-, 9-mth floater T-bills.

text.p: Yields rose on Monday for six and nine month maturities of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry floating interest T-bills as a rise in the central bank main interest rate took effect, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 26.91 and 41.56 percent, up from 24.26 and 37.72 percent at the respective auctions a week earlier.
The average accepted prices for the two issues auctioned on Monday were 97.94 and 96.38 percent of par compared to 97.76 and 96.01 percent for the two respective maturities auctioned on May 26.
Interest on the issues is due at maturity. It is set equal to the central bank main interest rate for each of the issues and floats with changes in the main rate.
A rise in the central bank main interest rate to 48.72 percent annually from previous 43.08 percent became effective on Monday.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 10,000 million levs 5,000 million levs
Bids received 13,735.1 million levs 6,020 million levs
Average price of bids 97.85 pct 96.40 pct
Bids approved 9,735 million levs 5,000 million levs
Average yield to maturity 26.91 pct 41.56 pct
